user.title: HAAC Bridge
user.description: Adds HAAC Bridge, which gives the HA Android Client a filtered view of your entities. After adding it, choose which users may see which entities under the options of the integration.

init.title: Users of the app
init.description: Choose which Home Assistant users the HA Android Client may show entities to. Users configured in configuration.yaml are not listed here and keep their YAML settings.

remove_user.title: Remove a user
remove_user.description: The app will show this user no entities.

filter.title: What may this user see?
filter.description: Only switches, sensors and climate devices are ever shown. Include at least one domain, entity or wildcard. An exclusion always wins over an inclusion. Wildcards look like `sensor.*_humidity`.

names.title: Names in the app
names.description: Optional names for the entities you included one by one. Leave a field empty to keep the Home Assistant name.

error.no_include: Choose at least one domain, entity or wildcard to include
error.invalid_glob: A wildcard must look like `domain.pattern`, for example `sensor.*_humidity`

abort.unknown: Something went wrong, please start again

cfg_invalid.message: The haac_bridge configuration in configuration.yaml is invalid

cfg_unknown_user.message: A user in the haac_bridge configuration does not exist in Home Assistant

auth_no_user.message: The request has no signed-in Home Assistant user

svc_not_allowed.message: You are not allowed to control this device

svc_not_available.message: This action is not available for this device

svc_failed.message: Home Assistant could not carry out the action

ent_not_found.message: This device no longer exists in Home Assistant

hist_unavailable.message: History is not available on this server

ws_invalid_request.message: The request could not be understood

int_unexpected.message: Something went wrong in HAAC Bridge

cfg_invalid.title: HAAC Bridge configuration is invalid (HAB-CFG-001)
cfg_invalid.description: The haac_bridge section in configuration.yaml could not be loaded, so the previous configuration stays active. Check the Home Assistant log for details, fix the configuration and run the action `haac_bridge.reload`.

cfg_unknown_user.title: HAAC Bridge user not found (HAB-CFG-002)
cfg_unknown_user.description: The haac_bridge configuration refers to the user `{user}`, which does not exist in Home Assistant. This entry exposes nothing. Correct the `username` or `user_id` and run the action `haac_bridge.reload`.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads the haac_bridge configuration from configuration.yaml.
